title: Shadow Puppet Theater with Animated Water Bottle
description: The user controls a shadow puppet theater where a ShadowmappableMesh casts dynamic shadows onto a stage floor while a WaterBottle performs choreographed animations. The user sequences keyframe animations by clicking timeline slots, adjusting rotation axes, easing functions, and playback speed to create a synchronized shadow dance performance.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive shadow puppet animation sequencer. Load both ShadowmappableMesh.glb and WaterBottle.glb using GLTFLoader. Set up a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 10) looking at the origin. Create a large light-gray plane at y=0 as the stage floor to receive shadows. Add a DirectionalLight at (3, 8, 5) with shadow mapping enabled (shadow map size 2048x2048, castShadow true). Both loaded models must have castShadow and receiveShadow set to true on all child meshes. Position ShadowmappableMesh at (-2, 1, 0) and WaterBottle at (2, 1, 0) scaled appropriately to be visually balanced. Create an HTML overlay panel at the bottom with a timeline containing 6 clickable slot buttons labeled 1-6. When the user clicks a slot, show a parameter panel with: (1) a dropdown to select which model to animate, (2) a dropdown for rotation axis (X, Y, Z), (3) a number input for rotation degrees (0-360, validated), (4) a dropdown for easing (linear, easeInOut, bounce), (5) a number input for duration in seconds (0.5-3.0, validated). Store each slot configuration. Add a Play button that sequentially executes all configured slots as chained animations using requestAnimationFrame with interpolation. During playback, the DirectionalLight should slowly orbit in a circle at radius 5 around the scene to create moving shadow effects on the floor. Add a Reset button that returns both models to their original transforms and clears the timeline. Validate that at least 3 slots are configured before allowing playback. Display a step counter showing current animation slot during playback. Use CSS styling for the overlay with semi-transparent dark background and white text. Ensure OrbitControls are attached for camera interaction between playback sessions.
